task.title: Fix bump() off-by-one
task.description: OpenCode live capture: make the three bump() tests pass with a minimal edit.

result.summary: Recorded session: 3/3 tests pass after 1 edit (recovered).
result.patch:
diff --git a/calc.mjs b/calc.mjs
index 752e015..f8c2880 100644
--- a/calc.mjs
+++ b/calc.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 export function bump(value) {
-  return value
+  return value + 1
 }
